policy: Catalog all newly observed empirical failures without modifying historical V3.2.1 failure records.

failures.description: Far-field out-of-sample uncertainty undercoverage beyond 8.0m boundary.
failures.trigger: Entity distance > 8.0m under low illumination (210 lux) in Sector D staging.
failures.observed_behavior: Empirical coverage dropped from 95.00% calibration in-sample down to 67.07% at >8.0m, and 92.61% across nominal ODD.
failures.safety_impact: Potential underestimation of coordinate uncertainty boundary if factor k is assumed universally valid beyond 8.0m.
failures.resolution: Enforce SafeRefusalEngine to clamp nominal autonomous intervention at <= 8.0m and trigger SAFE_REFUSAL_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE beyond 10.0m.

failures.description: Parallel-trend breakdown under exogenous traffic shock confounding causal attribution.
failures.trigger: Site shift change traffic surge (+38.5%) occurred during intervention evaluation window.
failures.observed_behavior: Control zone baseline drifted by +0.27 (>0.15 tolerance), invalidating the parallel-trend assumption.
failures.safety_impact: Risk of falsely attributing an exogenous traffic surge to the localized safety intervention.
failures.resolution: DifferenceInDifferencesEngine automatically triggered INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE status, refusing causal attribution.

failures.description: Identity switch during high-density worker and forklift crossing under partial visual occlusion.
failures.trigger: Worker passed within 0.8m of counterbalanced forklift mast with mutual occlusion.
failures.observed_behavior: Tracker swapped track IDs for 3 frames before spatial gating recovered track continuity.
failures.safety_impact: Temporary risk index attribution confusion between pedestrian and vehicle.
failures.resolution: Ambiguity scoring flags crossing as UNCERTAIN_IDENTITY and downgrades intervention to advisory warning.

failures.description: Non-planar incline dock ramp geometry causes homography reprojection distortion.
failures.trigger: Floor slope of 3.5 deg on dock south ramp exceeding 1.5 deg planar assumption.
failures.observed_behavior: Ground homography residual reached 0.08m, distorting metric distance calculation by > 0.25m.
failures.safety_impact: Distance underestimation could cause premature or delayed autonomous braking.
failures.resolution: GroundGeometryClassifier flags surface as NON_PLANAR_REFUSAL, triggering SAFE_REFUSAL_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

failures.description: Frame processing and transmission latency spike exceeding 500ms safety horizon.
failures.trigger: Simulated network congestion buffer bloat injecting 650ms telemetry lag.
failures.observed_behavior: Stale kinematic projection would act on outdated physical entity coordinates.
failures.safety_impact: High risk of braking on ghost hazard or failing to brake on active trajectory.
failures.resolution: Telemetry age gating immediately aborts autonomous control and triggers SAFE_REFUSAL_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
